title: Research report · Crocs (CROX)
disclaimer: Not financial advice. This is a research memo produced by Chris Camillo Tracker. It is not a trade, not affiliated with Camillo / Dumb Money / TickerTags, and it does not copy his 2–30% sizing or options book. Missing data is listed, never imputed. Lifetime totals are not momentum.
workflow_steps: Observe a real change versus your own baseline. Log it. Pull Trends (5-year), Wikipedia, and the relevant commerce / TikTok tags — as facts, with provenance.

Require two or three independent platforms showing a rise versus their own baseline. Lifetime TikTok totals and a single Amazon BSR sit in platforms_present_no_z: they do not count as a z. Missing platforms are listed, never imputed.
Open the 10-K segment note. Can this change move earnings at this company’s size? If not, stop.
Run the Street Consensus Profile. If already_priced, stand down. Only “niche rising and not clearly priced” survives.
Write the thesis and the exit (information parity, and “the tool is polluted”) before any action. The report is a prompt for human work, not a trade.

amazon_movers.method: Scrapling Fetcher of public Best Sellers pages; ranks from data-client-recs-list metadataMap.render.zg.rank; brand match on PRODUCT TITLE only (context matches discarded).
amazon_movers.notes: A Best Sellers rank is a position on one public list at one moment, not a z-score vs a baseline. Lululemon, Coach, and Elmer's were not in the top 50 of the category pages we fetched. Movers & Shakers returned no data-client-recs-list via Fetcher.
